dynamic_parts_Q26.label: CALCULATION
dynamic_parts_Q26.note: inertia of the nib assembly and plate effective masses referred to the nib; the benders' own stiffness is inside the actuator's load line and is not listed

skid.label: CALCULATION
skid.note: drag = mu_skid N_skid + mu_nib N_nib; plus the stage reaction of the moving mass (m_couple w^2 q)

protrusion.label: CALCULATION
protrusion.note: p >= r cot(theta) keeps the nib on the paper; the axial slide also follows the stage (s = q cot theta), so the travel covers tilt range plus stage accommodation

b_candidates.candidate: Piezo ultrasonic screw motor SQL-RV-1.8 (New Scale SQUIGGLE, AMF-15)
b_candidates.verdict: reject: 1 M-cycle life is 35 h of assisted writing at 8 Hz; ~1 W; speed marginal; not needed as a bias because the piezo stage holds at zero power

b_candidates.candidate: Shape-memory-alloy wire (NiTi, 50 um, antagonistic pair per axis)
b_candidates.verdict: reject: thermal bandwidth ~0.5 Hz (17x short at 8 Hz); efficiency ~1.6 %; continuous heating to hold

labels.properties: ASSUMPTION (NiTi density 6450 kg/m3, c 837 J/kgK, latent heat 24 J/g, h 200 W/m2K for a 50 um wire in still air, 3 % strain at 170 MPa); concept prior art PAT-06

b_candidates.candidate: Linear resonant actuator (6 mm coin, AMF-45) as a reaction-mass corrector
b_candidates.verdict: reject as corrector (moves no nib; output falls as (f/f_r)^2 below its 150-250 Hz resonance); haptic cue only, and the stage can cue itself (stage check)

b_candidates.candidate: Gyroscope (brass rotor 7 x 10 mm, 3.3 g, 50 000 rpm)
b_candidates.verdict: reject: gyroscopic torque 2 % of the hand's tremor torque; does not resist translation (the dominant nib tremor); precession cross-couples axes; spin-up power and 3 g

b_candidates.candidate: Reaction mass / active tuned-mass absorber (the 3.45 g cell moved +/-0.5 mm)
b_candidates.verdict: reject: 0.6-5.7 % of the grip-spring tremor force (575 N/m x 0.3 mm); needs ~68 g x mm

leaves.design_rule: across: E w t^3/L^3 <= 5 % of the axis stiffness; along: E t w^3/L^3 >= 20x; lateral-torsional buckling SF >= 2 at the plate's blocking force; cross-deflection stress <= 150 MPa alternating (AMF-19). A single leaf meets all four only with >= ~4.5 mm of free axial span
leaves.label: CALCULATION (beam theory; buckling factor ASSUMPTION, confirm by FEA); material AMF-18/19

sensor.label: CALCULATION (magpylib, linear magnet) with ASSUMPTIONS (Br 1.32 T, 0.3 mm element depth, 0.1 mT noise)
sensor.choice: 3-D Hall (TMAG5170/TLE493D class, SPI or I2C, >= 2 kSPS) in the nose facing a 0.6 x 1 x 1 mm NdFeB magnet on the collar; the piezo drive carries no current near it, so there is no coil crosstalk (unlike Rev A); piezo charge self-sensing kept as a plausibility check
